objects.text: The stone by the door reads:^{g}'PUZUR, MERCHANT. HE TOOK IT WITH HIM.'{/}| There is a second stone behind the first, with the list.~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.

objects.who: door|Shut. From inside: knocking. Three knocks, a wait, three knocks.^He does not want to be let out. He is making sure that somebody is there.| There is a gong beside the door, for callers.
objects.say: The gong sings. The knocking stops.^Then, very quickly, a great many bolts.

objects.text: The stone by the door reads:^{g}'IBBI. HE DID NOT LIKE TO BE A BOTHER.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.

objects.who: door|On the door, in chalk: {g}BACK IN FIVE MINUTES.{/}^The dust on the chalk is forty nights deep, and the door is barred on the inside.

objects.text: The stone by the door reads:^{g}'SHE SAID SHE WOULD ONLY BE A MINUTE.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.

objects.who: door|Shut. A rattle is cut over the door: a night watchman's.^The fire bowl beside it is cold. Whoever is inside has had enough of the dark, and is not opening the door to any more of it.
objects.say: Fire at the door: the first warm light on this hill in three hundred years.^Inside, a bar is lifted.| {g}'That's more like it,'{/} says somebody.

objects.text: The stone by the door reads:^{g}'A NIGHT WATCHMAN. HE NEVER ONCE SLEPT ON DUTY.'{/}| {g}'HE IS MAKING UP FOR IT.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.

The stone by the door reads:^{g}'ADAPA, SCRIBE. SIXTY TABLETS.'{/}| The mason has added, on his own account: {g}'I CUT NINE. NOBODY SHOULD HAVE TO CUT SIXTY.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.

{g}'USHUR AND BALTU, GENERALS. THEY KILLED EACH OTHER IN THE SAME BATTLE AT THE SAME MOMENT.'{/}^{g}'ONE BARROW. ONE DOOR. THE CITY WAS NOT MADE OF MONEY.'{/}~~In the dream the door of the barrow stands open, as it does awake.^Nobody on this hill locks anything. Nobody is expected to leave.
The stone reads:^{g}'HE COLLECTED TAXES. HE IS STILL OWED.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
The stone reads:^{g}'ASK ME ABOUT MY SONS.'{/}| Lower down, smaller: {g}'ON SECOND THOUGHT, DON'T.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
The stone reads:^{g}'LUGAL-ME, WHO WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE WELL.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
The stone reads:^{g}'I WAS NOT TIRED.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
